name: @w6w-apps/mailersend
description: Send transactional and bulk email with MailerSend, and manage templates, domains, sender identities, suppressions, webhooks, activity and analytics.

w6w.longDescription:
MailerSend is a transactional email service, and this app covers the whole sending loop a workflow needs: send a single email or up to 500 in one bulk request, optionally scheduled up to 72 hours ahead, with templates, per-recipient personalization, tags and attachments.

Around the send it covers what keeps mail deliverable: creating and verifying sending domains and reading the DNS records they need, sender identities for addresses without a verified domain, and the suppression lists (blocklist, hard bounces, spam complaints, unsubscribes, on-hold) that decide who is never mailed. After the send, it reads the individual emails, their delivery activity and the aggregate analytics, so a workflow can act on a bounce or an open, and it manages webhooks for reacting to those events as they happen.

MailerSend tokens are scoped per area, so a connection works with exactly the permissions it was given; an action that needs a scope the token lacks says so instead of failing opaquely. Health checks track MailerSend's own status page, live API reachability and the remaining daily request quota.
